articles.title: Market Shifts, New York’s Uniqueness Mean Mamdani’s Grocery Plan Could Work
articles.narrative: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani's plan to launch five government-subsidized grocery stores across the boroughs, offering significant discounts on essential items, is facing legal challenges and political opposition. Despite the hurdles, commercial real estate and grocery industry professionals believe the initiative could succeed, citing the city's unique market dynamics and the success of budget-friendly chains. The city has committed $70 million to cover construction and operational costs for the stores, with two locations already identified in Manhattan and the Bronx, and a request for proposals for an operator is underway.

data_points.project_notes: The $70 million commitment covers construction, rent, and other costs for five stores.

companies_people.label: OWNER
companies_people.firm_name: New York City Economic Development Corporation (NYCEDC)

articles.market_intelligence: New York City faces steadily rising grocery prices and declining foot traffic in grocery stores, contrasting with national trends. The city's grocery costs are 7.4% higher than the national average due to expensive truck-only shipping, high labor expenses, and top-tier real estate costs. There are approximately 1,000 full-service food stores and 13,000 bodegas citywide, with a significant disparity in grocery space per resident (1.5 SF/resident in NYC vs. 5-10 SF/resident nationally).

articles.title: CMBS Loan Backed by Hyatt Regency in Jersey City Sent to Special Servicing
articles.narrative: A $100 million CMBS loan secured by the Hyatt Regency hotel in Jersey City, NJ, has been transferred to special servicing due to an anticipated maturity default in October 2026. The sponsorship team, Taconic Capital Advisors and HEI Hotels & Resorts, indicated an inability to repay the loan. The hotel has consistently underperformed its net cash flow projections since the loan's 2016 origination, even reporting negative cash flow in 2024.

data_points.notable_features: Waterfront location on the Hudson River Waterfront Walkway, over 20,000 square feet of event space, fitness center, self-parking garage, and on-site restaurant. Five-minute walk from a New Jersey PATH train with access to Manhattan.
data_points.project_notes: The property was previously acquired by Taconic Capital Advisors and HEI Hotels & Resorts in December 2022 for $117 million. The loan is part of the CGCMT 2016-P5, CGCMT 2016-P6, and CMBX.10 conduit deals.

articles.title: Stockdale Capital Partners Aims for $300M in Loans by 2028 Via New Credit Platform
articles.narrative: Stockdale Capital Partners, a Los Angeles-based real estate investment firm, has launched a new real estate credit platform with the goal of deploying $300 million in loans over the next year. The platform will focus on senior bridge loans, mezzanine debt, special situation investments, and note purchases, with individual loan sizes expected to range from $15 million to $75 million. The firm will prioritize investments in office, life sciences, and hospitality assets across various U.S. regions, leveraging its vertically integrated operational expertise to efficiently underwrite transactions and structure flexible capital solutions for borrowers.

people.name: Alec Maki
people.title: Senior Vice President of Credit Investments

articles.title: Property Operations Platform Visitt Teams With VendorPM
articles.narrative: Visitt, an AI-native property operations platform, and VendorPM, a vendor lifecycle management company, have partnered to create a unified system for managing buildings and vendors. This collaboration aims to streamline daily operational workflows and ensure vendor compliance by integrating VendorPM's capabilities with Visitt's platform. The partnership addresses the industry trend of technology consolidation in commercial real estate, enabling property teams to work more efficiently and reduce complexity.

articles.title: New York City Selects It’s Electric to Install Curbside EV Charging Ports
articles.narrative: New York City has awarded It's Electric an exclusive contract to develop and install a permanent network of 700 curbside electric vehicle (EV) charging ports across all five boroughs. This initiative, managed by the city's Department of Transportation and the New York Power Authority, aims to replace existing pilot infrastructure and significantly expand EV charging access, particularly in neighborhoods with high concentrations of rideshare drivers and limited off-street parking. The project is expected to begin installation in the first quarter of 2027, following a review by the Public Design Commission, and will support the city's climate goals by accelerating EV adoption and creating local manufacturing jobs.

data_points.notable_features: The project involves replacing 88 existing pilot ports and installing over 600 new chargers, with all chargers manufactured in Queens, NY.
data_points.project_notes: The contract is for a minimum five-year operational period. The city will retain revenue from the charging stations and set pricing.

companies_people.firm_name: Partnership Fund for New York City

articles.financing: It's Electric closed an oversubscribed bridge fundraising round, bringing its total funding to date to $15 million.

articles.title: BWE Secures $101M Loan for New Active Adult Community in Jacksonville
articles.narrative: BWE has secured a $101 million bridge loan for the refinancing of RISE at Glen Kernan Park, a new active adult community in Jacksonville, FL. The three-year, floating-rate loan was provided by BlackRock affiliate HPS to the borrower, RISE, A Real Estate Company. The financing will be used to retire existing construction and mezzanine loans and fund reserves during the lease-up phase of the property.

data_points.notable_features: Community reserved for households age 55 and older, featuring luxury apartments and single-story cottage units with attached garages. Amenities include a fitness facility, resort-style pool, pickleball courts, and a bar and lounge room.
data_points.project_notes: Monthly rental rates range from $1,704 to $3,871.

articles.title: Piedmont Realty Trust Acquires Office Building in Arlington, Virginia for $56.3M
articles.narrative: Piedmont Realty Trust Inc. has acquired a 188,014-square-foot office building in Arlington, VA, for $56.3 million. The property, located in the Ballston submarket, was sold by a partnership that had invested approximately $6 million in capital improvements, leading to significant new leasing activity. The building features a strong tenant mix, including office and ground-level retail occupants.

data_points.project_notes: Sellers previously acquired the property in September 2024 and invested $6 million in capital improvements.

articles.title: MMCC Arranges $53M Refinancing for Build-to-Rent Property in Rogers, Arkansas
articles.narrative: Marcus & Millichap Capital Corp. (MMCC) has secured a $53 million nonrecourse refinancing loan for The Grove, a 235-unit build-to-rent residential community in Rogers, Arkansas. The three-year loan was arranged for a joint venture between Brittenum Group and Realty Capital Partners. The property, built in 2024, was 94.5 percent occupied at the time of the financing.

data_points.notable_features: The community features 123 detached cottages and 112 attached townhomes, with amenities including a resort-style pool, fitness center, golf simulator, coworking offices, and a pickleball court.

articles.title: Colliers Negotiates $23M Sale of Shopping Center in Trinity, Florida
articles.narrative: Colliers has facilitated the sale of Trinity Village Center, a 76,834-square-foot shopping center in Trinity, Florida, approximately 30 miles north of Tampa. Crow Holdings acquired the property for $23 million. The center was 93 percent leased at the time of sale, featuring a strong tenant mix.

articles.title: Stockdale Capital Partners, Hamilton Lane Acquire Shoppes at Chino Hills in California for $157M
articles.narrative: Stockdale Capital Partners, in partnership with funds managed by Hamilton Lane, has acquired The Shoppes at Chino Hills, an open-air lifestyle center in Chino Hills, California, for $157 million. The new ownership plans to rename the property The Shops at Chino Hills and implement a rebranding, remerchandising, and repositioning strategy. The center, originally developed in 2008, features a strong tenant mix including a popular grocery store and bookstore, serving a significant local customer base.

data_points.address: 13920 City Center Drive, Chino Hills, CA
data_points.notable_features: Open-air lifestyle center anchored by a grocery store and bookstore, serving over 300,000 residents within a five-mile radius.

articles.title: Marcus & Millichap closes sale of 72,551-square-foot shopping center in Granbury
articles.narrative: Marcus & Millichap has brokered the off-market sale of Granbury Lakeside Center, a 72,551-square-foot shopping center in Granbury, Texas. The fully leased property, built in 2019, was acquired by a private buyer from a private seller. The buyer intends to maintain the center as a stabilized retail investment.

data_points.notable_features: Located along Granbury's primary retail corridor, near major retailers.

articles.title: PMCRE, ICO Commercial closes 6,985-square-foot office sublease in Houston
articles.narrative: PMCRE and ICO Commercial have successfully completed a 6,985-square-foot office sublease at 10300 Town Park Drive in Houston, Texas. This transaction highlights the ongoing demand for strategically located office properties within the Houston/Westchase submarket.

articles.title: Construction moving along on Seefried’s 502,000-square-foot industrial development in Des Plaines
articles.narrative: Seefried Industrial Properties is progressing with the construction of a three-building, 520,000-square-foot Class-A industrial development in Des Plaines, IL, following the demolition of three obsolete office buildings. This speculative project, located in the O'Hare submarket, aims to provide modern logistics, distribution, and manufacturing space in a supply-constrained market. The development highlights Seefried's expertise in complex infill redevelopment, transforming existing sites into facilities designed for contemporary industrial users.

data_points.notable_features: Class-A industrial development designed for modern logistics, distribution, and manufacturing users, featuring efficient site circulation, modern loading configurations, and trailer parking.
data_points.project_notes: Redevelopment of approximately 35 acres at the Northeast corner of Algonquin Road and Mount Prospect Road, transforming three functionally obsolete office buildings into a modern industrial park. The project is being developed on a speculative basis.

articles.title: Loop Adjacent: Small-bay project fills a gap in East Pilsen
articles.narrative: Podmajersky, Inc. is developing a 12,000-square-foot speculative industrial facility in Chicago's East Pilsen neighborhood, addressing a critical shortage of modern small-bay industrial space near the Loop. The project, scheduled for 2027 delivery, aims to attract food users, industrial distributors, and service companies that require quick access to the central business district and major highways. The developer, known for its work in the East Pilsen arts district, is designing the new building to blend with the area's historic architecture while offering modern features like 24-foot clear heights and flexible power capacity.

data_points.notable_features: 24-foot clear heights, dock and drive-in loading, flexible power capacity, Enterprise Zone incentives, located 600 feet from I-90/I-55 interchange and 2.5 miles from downtown.
data_points.project_notes: The developer has owned the parcel for years and shifted its vision for the site as industrial users were pushed out of Fulton Market. The design borrows from the adjacent 900 W. Cermak Road building, featuring Chicago common brick and a scale that fits historic commercial structures.

articles.market_intelligence: Avison Young's Q2 2026 Chicago Industrial report indicates no available Class-A industrial buildings between 10,000 and 20,000 square feet within a five-mile radius of 2100 S. Canalport Ave. The Pilsen market is experiencing growth across all property types, including office, retail, industrial, and residential.

articles.title: Buffalo Grove’s PREMIER Design + Build Group adds project executive
articles.narrative: PREMIER Design + Build Group, based in Buffalo Grove, Illinois, has appointed Charles Worrell as Project Executive. In this role, Worrell will focus on expanding the company's market presence and strengthening client relationships, particularly within its Connecticut team. He brings over two decades of experience in construction and development, having successfully delivered significant projects across various sectors, including residential, mixed-use, commercial, and hospitality.

articles.title: Marcus & Millichap’s Azzi Group Handles Sale of Section 8 Housing on Catalina Island
articles.narrative: The Azzi Group of Marcus & Millichap has facilitated the sale of Tremont Street Apartments, a 62-unit affordable housing complex on Santa Catalina Island, for $8.64 million. The transaction involved navigating a complex structure including a ground lease, HUD approval, a Housing Assistance Payments (HAP) contract assignment, and a Freddie Mac loan assumption, ensuring the preservation of affordable housing in the Avalon community. The property was marketed on behalf of the seller, Black Rose Catalina L.P., and acquired by Tailwind Investment Group.

data_points.notable_features: Operates under a Section 8 Housing Assistance Payments contract.
data_points.project_notes: Subject to a ground lease with the Santa Catalina Island Company through 2053.

articles.title: Upper Manhattan Empowerment Zone Signs New Headquarters Lease
articles.narrative: The Upper Manhattan Empowerment Zone Development Corporation (UMEZ) has signed a new 9,000-square-foot headquarters lease on the sixth floor of the Urban League Empowerment Center at 119 W. 125th St. UMEZ has been involved with the mixed-use development since 2020, providing construction financing for the project which includes affordable housing, commercial office and retail space, and a civil rights museum. The organization will join other notable office tenants in the building.

data_points.address: 119 W. 125th St, New York City, NY
data_points.notable_features: Mixed-use development including affordable housing, commercial office and retail space, and the Urban Civil Rights Museum.
data_points.project_notes: UMEZ served as a lender on the construction of the project since 2020.

articles.title: Bridge Logistics Properties Targets Northern California Assets
articles.narrative: Bridge Logistics Properties (BLP) is actively pursuing industrial acquisitions across Northern California, adapting its strategy to evolving market dynamics. The firm is targeting well-located, functional, second-generation assets along the I-880 corridor, particularly in Fremont and San Jose, where Class A supply is tightening due to demand from AI, advanced manufacturing, and technology sectors. Concurrently, BLP is investing in Central Valley markets like Stockton, capitalizing on logistics demand migrating eastward. This dual-market approach reflects BLP's view of an interconnected Northern California industrial market, aiming to capture demand where it is created, displaced, and where supply is constrained.

data_points.notable_features: Second-generation industrial assets located along the I-880 corridor.

articles.title: Electronics Company Acquires Flex Industrial for Headquarters Use
articles.narrative: A-V Services Realty LLC, an electronics and technology company, has acquired a 40,000-square-foot industrial flex property at 60 E. Rte. 46 in Fairfield, NJ, to establish its first owned headquarters. The acquisition allows the company to secure a long-term home within striking distance of New York City, eliminating the need for future lease negotiations. Renovations are scheduled to begin in November.

data_points.notable_features: Two-story design allows for separation of office and warehouse operations, supporting office, light industrial, showroom, and distribution functions.

articles.title: Cabot Cabot & Forbes Tops Off Construction at Woburn Innovation Center
articles.narrative: Cabot, Cabot & Forbes (CC&F) has topped off construction at The Bolt, a 180,000-square-foot innovation center in Woburn, MA. This milestone marks significant progress in CC&F's $400 million redevelopment of a former Superfund site along the New Boston Corridor. The project is being built on spec and is expected to attract a diverse array of innovative companies to the region.

data_points.notable_features: Located along the New Boston Corridor on a former Superfund site.
data_points.project_notes: Part of CC&F's $400 million redevelopment investment in the area.

articles.title: Daniel Negari Buys Downtown LA Hotel For $34M
articles.narrative: Daniel Negari has acquired Hotel Per La in Los Angeles for $34 million. This transaction marks a significant investment in the downtown Los Angeles hospitality market.

data_points.address: 649 S Olive St, Los Angeles, CA

articles.title: Downtown Atlanta Improvement Group Picks Food Bank Chief As Next Leader
articles.narrative: Kyle Waide, the current CEO of the Atlanta Community Food Bank, has been selected as the next leader of Downtown Atlanta, Inc. In his new role, Waide will be responsible for fostering community growth and building coalitions within the downtown area.

articles.title: Goldman Sachs Pays $154M For Davie Apartments: The South Florida Deal Sheet
articles.narrative: Goldman Sachs has acquired a newly delivered 397-unit multifamily property in Davie, Florida, for $154 million. The asset, completed last year, is strategically located near Nova Southeastern University.

articles.title: Bucks County Mall Closing As Owners Prepare Redevelopment Plans
articles.narrative: The Bucks County Mall is scheduled for closure as its owners, Paramount Realty and Edgewood Properties, are preparing to redevelop the property.
